question: Can this product create a native B20 ASSET fixture on Base Sepolia?
method: eth_call (read-only simulation, no transaction broadcast) of IB20Factory.createB20 with
variant=ASSET(0), a fixed salt, and an ABI-encoded B20AssetCreateParams(version=1, name,
symbol, initialAdmin, decimals=8). A variant that is not activated reverts with
FeatureNotActivated(bytes32) (selector 0xb9b2a425); this call returned an address instead.
Cross-checked against IB20Factory.getB20Address for the same (variant, sender, salt),
which returned the identical address, and against isB20Initialized, which returned false
— confirming the simulation predicted a creation rather than reporting an existing token.
whyIsActivatedWasNotUsed: IActivationRegistry.isActivated(bytes32) is the documented gate, but the feature-key
encoding is not derivable from the pinned base-std sources. keccak("B20Asset") and the
right-padded bytes32("B20Asset") both return false on Base MAINNET, where B20 assets
demonstrably exist — so the key is something else and any value we tried would be a guess.
Guessing a key and reporting its answer as a capability would be worse than not asking.
The behavioural probe above needs no key and answers the question directly.
deploymentAuthorization: NOT AUTHORIZED. Nothing has been deployed. contracts/script/DeployBaseSepolia.s.sol prepares the deployment and runs only when a human invokes it with --broadcast.
mainnetBoundary: The same simulation was run against Base mainnet as a read-only eth_call to compare behaviour. No transaction was broadcast to chain 8453 and no write path to it exists in this repository.
